description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a Fragment subclass that manages a LogView inside a ScrollView for displaying log data in an Android application. It includes methods for view inflation, setting up the log view appearance, and handling text change events to auto-scroll.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that contains a LogView within a ScrollView, used for displaying log messages with auto-scrolling functionality.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, appearance, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the views, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
